related.title: MAGMA：批次小矩陣與啟動攤提
related.titleEn: MAGMA: batched small matrices and launch amortization
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付相依圖、向量化診斷與alias反例；10/13正確，轉換後逐元素吻合且每項編譯假設有證據；請另一位學徒依交付件重新推導一組；未通過或資料不足必須明記，不以品牌或峰值取代證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver dependency graphs, vectorizer remarks, and aliasing counterexamples. Verify final values 10 and 13 and every intermediate element. Supply evidence for all compiler assumptions. Have another learner derive one case from the handover; label failures or missing evidence without substituting brand names or peak rates.
related.difference: 列100矩陣的shape、stride與唯一ID，畫100launch和1launch的時間帳；2500/520與完整820帳一致，100矩陣結果無覆寫。
related.differenceEn: List shapes, strides, and unique identities for all 100 matrices. Draw 100 launches versus one launch. Verify 2500 and 520, include the complete 820-microsecond scenario, and check all 100 results for overwrites.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 遞迴a[i]=a[i−1]+1有跨迭代相依，與a[i]=b[i]+1的獨立元素不同；合成a0=2，遞迴做到i8；另起a0=5，仍8次遞迴；名義式 2+8 = 10 a[8]；變更式 5+8 = 13 a[8]。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
獨立k工作每次launch l與compute c，Tseparate=k(l+c)；理想一批Tbatch=l+kc；合成k100、l20微秒、c5微秒；比較逐次與理想單批，忽略額外打包；名義式 100*(20+5) = 2500 microseconds；變更式 20+100*5 = 520 microseconds。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: The recurrence a[i] = a[i−1]+1 depends on the previous iteration, unlike independent assignments a[i] = b[i]+1. Synthetic initial a [0] = 2 through i = 8; compare initial value 5 with the same eight updates. Nominal 2+8 = 10 a[8]; changed 5+8 = 13 a[8]. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.

Separate jobs cost k(l+c); an ideal single batch costs l+kc for launch cost l and work c per job. Synthetic k = 100, l = 20 microseconds, c = 5 microseconds. Compare separate launches with one ideal batch, excluding packing. Nominal 100*(20+5) = 2500 microseconds; changed 20+100*5 = 520 microseconds. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.differenceEn: Reconstruct InfiniBand fat tree: uplink oversubscription and cuts with synthetic data; distinguish architecture facts, model assumptions and acceptance evidence. Complete: Deliver port tables, normal/failed cuts and local versus cross-layer traffic comparisons.
